# U176: The admin’s workspace line on Home, drawn: in a workspace with 12 people and one admin, Rosa’s Home has a block headed with the workspace’s name, “{n} things to sort out” with the first one’s sentence and “See them”; See them opens About, whose To sort out list has the same {n}; a member sees none of it, and a two-person workspace just set up has none either

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `HOME-LEADER`
- **Budget:** at most 5 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `one-action`, `a11y`, `logged` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U176

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The menu (the sidebar on a computer, the tab bar on a phone) shows.
- _Note:_ Day one: Rosa and Omar, nothing to sort out, so no line.
- A workspace of its own in the browser's storage: Rosa Lind (its admin) and Omar Haddad, then more people from the demo's, one team with no lead, four goals and a weekly review (`seedFieldWorkspace(p, 2)`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page (`.page`) shows.
- **Check:** A heading shows.
- _Note:_ A year on: 12 people and still one admin (and a team with no lead): something to sort out.
- A workspace of its own in the browser's storage: Rosa Lind (its admin) and Omar Haddad, then more people from the demo's, one team with no lead, four goals and a weekly review (`seedFieldWorkspace(p, 12)`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The home sort out (`.home-sort-out`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `day1 === 0 && title === 'Field Operations' && n >= 2 && /You’re the only admin/.test(said) && /, and \d+ more\./.test(said) && /See them$/.test(said)`, where `const day1 = await p.locator('.home-sort-out').count()`; `const row = p.locator('.home-sort-out')`; `const block = p.locator('[data-part="The workspace’s line"]')`; `const title = (await block.getByRole('heading').first().innerText()).trim()`; `const said = (await row.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`; `const n = Number((said.match(/^(\d+) things? to sort out/) || [])[1])`. Else it says: day one had {day1} lines; the block is headed “{title}”, the line says “{said}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “See them” link in the home sort out (`.home-sort-out`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace”.
- **Check:** The “To sort out” list shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `rows === n`, where `const row = p.locator('.home-sort-out')`; `const said = (await row.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`; `const n = Number((said.match(/^(\d+) things? to sort out/) || [])[1])`; `const list = p.getByRole('list', { name: 'To sort out' })`; `const rows = await list.locator('.ws-sort-row').count()`. Else it says: Home said {n} things to sort out; About lists {rows}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “about”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ A member sees none of it.
- Look as Omar (`omar`) in the workspace `ws_field` from here on, as choosing them in the Demo panel does (the browser’s storage: `goals-app-viewer:ws_field` is `omar`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page (`.page`) shows.
- **Check:** A heading shows.
- **Check:** (`errors`) the home sort out, or the “The workspace’s line” part (`.home-sort-out, [data-part="The workspace’s line"]`) is not there (else: a member’s Home shows the workspace’s line).
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
